# has attestation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasAttestation`](gmeow-hasAttestation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAttestation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity to an attestation about it — the inverse of [`gmeow:attestedSubject`](gmeow-attestedSubject.md). Non-functional: an entity may have many co-existing attestations from different attesters ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasAttestation`](gmeow-hasAttestation.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

```turtle
# --- A credential: an independent attestation OF the skill, by an issuer. A
#     verifiable credential references a gmeow:Attestation that signs it (the
#     expertise↔attestation seam): the credential is a CLAIM, the attestation
#     makes it checkable.
ex:cert a gmeow:Credential ;
    gmeow:credentialFor    ex:python ;
    gmeow:credentialIssuer ex:psf ;
    gmeow:hasAttestation   ex:certAttestation .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use from an entity to enumerate the attestations vouching for it — the entity-rooted inverse of [`gmeow:attestedSubject`](gmeow-attestedSubject.md), when traversing from the thing to who has vouched for it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when you can state [`gmeow:attestedSubject`](gmeow-attestedSubject.md) instead (prefer the attestation-rooted direction and read this as its inverse), and avoid treating one attestation as authoritative — multiple coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:attestedSubject`](gmeow-attestedSubject.md) on the [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) and read [`gmeow:hasAttestation`](gmeow-hasAttestation.md) by inversion; reach for it explicitly in entity-rooted projections that list every vouching envelope for a subject.
